# statuspage_subscriber (Resource)

Manages a Statuspage subscriber.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "statuspage_subscriber" "email" {
  page_id       = "abc123def456"
  email         = "user@example.com"
  component_ids = [statuspage_component.api.id]

  skip_confirmation_notification = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `page_id` (String)

### Optional

- `component_ids` (List of String)
- `email` (String)
- `endpoint` (String) Webhook endpoint URL.
- `phone_country` (String)
- `phone_number` (String)
- `skip_confirmation_notification` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `mode` (String)
